subtitle: Every TV. One remote.
promotionalText: One remote for VIZIO, Roku, Samsung, LG and Google TV. Tap a tile and your show opens on the big screen. Pay once: no ads, no subscription, no tracking.
description:
Couch Remote turns your iPhone into a fast, gorgeous remote for the smart TVs in your house, and your Windows PC too. Pay once, keep it forever. No ads, no subscription, no tracking.

WORKS WITH
• VIZIO SmartCast TVs (2016 and newer)
• Roku TVs and Roku players: TCL, Hisense, onn., Sharp, Insignia Roku TVs, plus every Roku stick and box
• Samsung Smart TVs (Tizen, 2016 and newer)
• LG Smart TVs (webOS, 2014 and newer)
• Google TV and Android TV: Sony, TCL and Hisense Google TV, Philips Android TV, Chromecast with Google TV, Nvidia Shield
Your phone and TV must be on the same Wi-Fi.
Doesn't work with: Amazon Fire TV, Apple TV, game consoles, or older TVs without built-in smart features.

TAP A TILE, IT OPENS ON THE TV
Your streaming apps live on big glowing tiles. Tap one and it launches on your TV in a second. Pick from more than 100 apps.

A REMOTE THAT FEELS GOOD
Swipe anywhere on the pad to move, tap to select. Back, Home and Menu are one tap away, plus play/pause, skip, a big volume rocker you can hold, mute, input and power.

EVERY TV IN THE HOUSE
Add the living room Samsung, the bedroom Roku and the basement VIZIO. Switch TVs with one tap. Moved a TV or changed your router? Couch Remote finds it again on its own.

ON YOUR WRIST
Steer, change the volume with the Digital Crown and open apps from your Apple Watch.

YOUR PC, FROM BED
Install the free PC companion and your phone becomes a trackpad and keyboard for your Windows PC: move the mouse, scroll, type, control media and volume, and open apps.

SET UP IN SECONDS
Couch Remote finds your TV on your Wi-Fi automatically. Depending on the TV you type the code it shows, choose Allow on the TV, or nothing at all.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no servers. Couch Remote talks only to your TV and your PC, directly over your home network.

Couch Remote is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by VIZIO, Roku, Samsung, LG, Google or Microsoft. These names, and streaming service names, are trademarks of their owners and are used only to describe compatibility.
